svg.title: Map of Irad
svg.desc: Topographic map of Irad with its neighbours, main rivers, ranges, peaks, cities and the Qara-Chik Demarcation Line. Irad's border, the line, peaks and cities: Kartalar map data. Relief: SRTM elevation data via the AWS Terrain Tiles (public domain). Neighbours and water: Natural Earth (public domain); Chu, Talas and Chatkal rivers © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
